_readme: The ONE catalog of the superbased SDKs (review P-11, first-run plan revision 2 section 3.9, lane C0): one row per language with its package, install lines, published flag and init snippet. The apps read it through shared/lib/sdkCatalog.ts (web's AI Apps first-run card, web2's Settings > Apps & SDKs facts); the marketing page generator replaces @@sdk.<id>.<field>@@ and @@sdk.languages@@ tokens from it (website/docs-tools/pagegen/sdk.go); scripts/sdk-install-strings.py checks it and flips the published flags on the SDK release. A new language is one more row here and nothing else. `install_checkout` is shown while `published` is false, `install_published` once it is true. `release` names what publishes the row: "sdk-release" is .github/workflows/sdk-release.yml on an sdk-v<x.y.z> tag (sdk-install-strings.py flip sets these rows); "none" means no workflow publishes it yet and the flag is flipped by hand (sdk-install-strings.py flip --sdk <id>). The snippets send to this machine's receiver (127.0.0.1:4318), the SDKs' default.

sdks.label: Python
sdks.install_checkout: pip install ./sdk/python  # from a checkout: not on PyPI yet
snippet: sb.init(service_name="my-app")  # sends to this machine at 127.0.0.1:4318

sdks.label: TypeScript
sdks.install_checkout: npm install ./sdk/typescript  # from a checkout: not on npm yet
snippet: init({ serviceName: "my-app" }); // sends to this machine at 127.0.0.1:4318
const answer = observe(async (q: string) => agent.run(q), { name: "answer", kind: Kind.AGENT });

sdks.label: Go
sdks.install_checkout: go mod edit -require=github.com/superbasedapp/observer/sdk/go@v0.0.0 -replace=github.com/superbasedapp/observer/sdk/go=<checkout>/sdk/go && go mod tidy  # from a checkout: not tagged yet
snippet: superbased.Init(ctx, superbased.Options{ServiceName: "my-app"}) // sends to this machine at 127.0.0.1:4318
answer, err := superbased.Observe(ctx, "answer", superbased.KindAgent, func(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
